# Hermes Helmet

> Hermes Helmet is an open-source software factory that gives Hermes Agent the ability to keep going, carrying accepted GitHub work through implementation, review, repair and authorized merge.

The product name in prose is Hermes Helmet. The CLI is `helmet`. You are the Captain; your coding agent is the first officer on the Captain side; Hermes is the crew and implements under a separate worker identity. This file is an index into the public repository, not a second manual. Digest and tag values live in the runtime image guide.

## Task routing

- Changing this repository: [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/AGENTS.md) and [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Run `scripts/verify.sh`.
- Implementing or repairing one GitHub issue: [helmet-issue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/skills/helmet-issue/SKILL.md).
- Coordinating dependent issues: [helmet-epic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/skills/helmet-epic/SKILL.md).
- Configuring identities and the worker: [setup-helmet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/skills/setup-helmet/SKILL.md).
- Starting or upgrading the published image: [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/quickstart.md) and [Published runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/runtime-image.md).
- Company policy, mounts, and state: [Private overlay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/private-overlay.md). Optional; not a product prerequisite.
- Reporting a vulnerability: [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue with an exploit or a secret.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/README.md): Product overview, roles, planning boundary, and documentation map.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/quickstart.md): Install the host CLI and start the published worker image. The CLI install does not pull or restart the worker.
- [Published runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/runtime-image.md): Canonical image pin, Compose selection, development builds, and upgrades.

## Setup and delivery skills

- Installing first-officer skills into Claude Code or Codex: [First-officer plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/first-officer-plugins.md). Plugin install copies instructions only.
- [setup-helmet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/skills/setup-helmet/SKILL.md): Configure identities, repositories, model access, and the worker runtime.
- [helmet-issue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/skills/helmet-issue/SKILL.md): Carry one GitHub issue through implementation, review, repair, and acceptance.
- [helmet-epic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/skills/helmet-epic/SKILL.md): Coordinate dependent issues and dispatch ready children.

## Operating model

- [Captain, first officer, and crew](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/captain-and-crew.md): Roles, delivery contract, and merge authority. The worker never merges.
- [Authority schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/authority-schema.md): Policy fields for identities, allowlists, labels, budgets, and merge rules.
- [Control loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/control-loop.md): Issue intake, trusted review, same-PR repair, and the merge gate.
- [setup-helmet reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/setup-helmet.md): Setup commands and diagnostics.
- [helmet-issue reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/helmet-issue.md): Captain-side single-issue orchestration.
- [helmet-epic reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/helmet-epic.md): Captain-side dependent-issue orchestration.

## Company overlay

- [Private overlay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/docs/private-overlay.md): Keep company policy, mounts, and state outside this repository. Optional; not a product prerequisite.

## Contribute

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for agents changing this repository.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Branch, verification, and pull-request rules. Run `scripts/verify.sh`.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MachineWisdomAI/hermes-helmet/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting. Do not open a public issue with an exploit or a secret.
